[EN] A Little Help
[ES] Una pequeña ayuda
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You're passing through. We have to stay.
[ES] Solo estás de paso. Nosotros debemos quedarnos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We kill them, but there are always more.
[ES] Los matamos, pero siempre hay más.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@Creature:45#1001#kelba chargers} east of the {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach}.
[ES] Mata {@Creature:45#1001#kelba chargers} al este del {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@Rgn:45010$$Valor Watchpoint} and talk to Laskan.
[ES] Ve a {@Rgn:45010$$Valor Watchpoint} y habla con Laskan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
